summary: Owner check-14 decision recorded as D6 (refining D4) in architecture-decision-ledger.md: same authoritative source snapshot + independently versioned Data-Agent-owned transform; shared-snapshot limit is a typed Coverage Gap; second source optional behind P2; comparison rule versioned and policy-owned; no tolerance, P2, implementation authority, or pass verdict invented. Minimum technology-neutral check-14 contract defined in architecture-design-draft.md (§6.2/§6.3 and F18) and will be carried into the final design.

check14_contract_minimum.source_snapshot_identity: immutable snapshot id + interval + scope + source receipt shared by primary read and recomputation
check14_contract_minimum.transform_independence: independence_class in {independent_source, independent_transform, same_pipeline}; M0 minimum independent_transform; Data-Agent-owned, deterministic, versioned separately from reporting/scorecard transform
check14_contract_minimum.receipts: input manifest, transform digest, output digest, recomputation receipt
check14_contract_minimum.deterministic_comparison: versioned comparison_rule_id owned by DecisionMetricPolicy; no numeric tolerance invented here
check14_contract_minimum.fail_closed: MISSING or conflicting snapshot identity, missing receipt, or same_pipeline -> check 14 UNKNOWN -> material -> analysis_use not_permitted, next_safe_action evidence_collection
check14_contract_minimum.shared_source_coverage_gap: coverage_gap_kind shared_source_snapshot recorded on every M0 packet whose recomputation shares the primary snapshot
